adjudication.rationale: In `packages/features/bookings/lib/handleNewBooking.ts`, `teamMemberPromises` changed from a guarded `users.length > 1 ? users.slice(1).map(...) : []` to always doing `users.slice(1).map(...)` and the mapped object now includes `firstName: ""` and `lastName: ""` (previously not present). While `users.slice(1)` still yields `[]` for single-user bookings (so behavior is effectively the same there), the additional empty-string fields are a real shape change for `teamMembers` passed downstream (e.g., via `team: { members: teamMembers }`), which could impact snapshot/email rendering expectations and is arguably out of scope for the destinationCalendar/collective intent.
